title: eludite.workspace.open_folder output
description: What the shell found at the folder's root and started loading. The Workspace window shows the folder root with the .NET solution and the Cargo workspace as siblings under it; eludite.workspace.tree lists them once loaded.

root.description: Absolute path of the opened folder.

state.description: loading: the folder listing, the solution and the Cargo metadata are being read.

solution.description: Absolute path of the .NET solution found at the root and handed to eludite-host, when there is one.

cargo_manifest.description: Absolute path of the Cargo.toml whose workspace is being read, when there is one.
